messages:
anya: Heads-up, ran into an SDK vs REST parity issue during onboarding: Python SDK + sampleapp requesting massive token counts when retry is enabled.
liam: oh no. what call and which param?
anya: sampleapp calls client.chat.generate(model="redwood-1", prompt=msg, max_tokens=20, retry=2). REST equivalent with same body stays within 20 tokens.
corey: any logs from the SDK transport layer? could be a serializer mismatch on retry.
anya: dug in: first attempt payload = {"max_tokens":20,...} second attempt payload = {"token_budget":-9999,...} (a sentinel). Model accepts negative sentinel as unlimited and returns ~1024 tokens.
infra: that sentinel was introduced for an internal quota feature. Looks like the retry path resets some fields to sentinel when copying the request.
liam: can you paste the minimal repro?
anya: here's the exact snippet from sampleapp: 
```py
# sampleapp/src/onboard.py
resp = client.chat.generate(
    model='redwood-1',
    prompt=user_prompt,
    max_tokens=20,
    retry=2
)
print(resp.text[:200])
```
corey: repro is clear. Behavior diverges only when retry > 0. If retry=0 or omitted, SDK preserves max_tokens.
liam: patch plan: make retry wrapper deepcopy the original payload and ensure no migration to internal sentinel keys happens in the retry copy. Add test asserting identical JSON across attempts.
infra: also recommend server-side guard: reject token_budget < 0 with 4xx rather than treating it as unlimited. Safer.
anya: opened issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/2765 with logs and stack trace.
deploy-bot: CI: sampleapp-smoke (PR #452) failed: one test shows token usage spike.
corey: temporary mitigation for onboarding: set retry=None in deployed sampleapp and add app-level max_tokens clamp.
liam: add an integration test in CI that calls the public REST endpoint and the SDK path and diff token counts to detect regressions.
infra: I'll add alerting: if avg tokens/request for project onboarding > 3x baseline, create pager.
anya: FYI I submitted a tiny PR that stops mutation in the retry copy + unit test. Request review.
liam: nice, add changelog note and mention mapping between max_tokens and token_budget in SDK docs so users aren't surprised.
corey: also audit other SDK languages for the same retry serialization pattern. Could be in node/java too.
anya: thanks all, leaving workaround notes in sampleapp readme and monitoring costs this week. :pray:
